banjo.line: Don’t make me scratch on your door, I never left you for a banjo
stanza: Don’t make me scratch on your door, I never left you for a banjo
I only just turned around for a poodle and a corvette
And my impression of my best Angie Dickenson
But now I’ve got to worry
Massa made de darkeys love him
Now de sadly weep above him
I try to drive away my sorrow
